title: Hosting contract summary
prompt:
Summarize this contract in at most 90 words and at least 35 words.

Source: Harbor Hosting will provide the service for 12 months starting 2026-04-01. The fee is $4800. Either party may end the contract with 30 days notice. The contract does not grant unlimited seats.

The summary must mention Harbor Hosting, 12 months, $4800, 30 days, and 2026-04-01. Do not write "unlimited".
constraints: Keeps the vendor, term, fee, notice, and start date
